summary: The first mismatch originates before the queue annotation teleport.c:collect_coords. When a gremlin-form hero falls into a pool, trap.c:drown() takes its successful rn2(3) split branch and calls potion.c:split_mon(&youmonst, NULL). JavaScript trap.js:drown() instead records note_unported("mon.c split_mon"), although the canonical potion.js:split_mon() and its cloneu() dependency are already implemented. C then creates the second gremlin through mhitu.c:cloneu() -> makemon.c:makemon() -> teleport.c:enexto_core() -> collect_coords(); that downstream placement is why collect_coords owns the next C RNG entry, not the source defect.

source.branch: In drown(), after hero inventory water_damage_chain(), if u.umonnum == PM_GREMLIN and rn2(3) is nonzero, C calls (void) split_mon(&gy.youmonst, NULL). The return is discarded; potion.c:split_mon() clamps current polymorph HP, conditionally calls cloneu() when u.mh > 1, divides current and maximum HP between the hero and clone, sets disp.botl, and prints "You multiply!" only when a clone is returned. The selected C record reaches this branch at segment 0 step 37. JavaScript currently skips it with note_unported("mon.c split_mon"), despite an existing complete potion.c:split_mon owner.
callers: The selected production path is ordinary hero movement into a pool: hack.c:pooleffects() calls drown() and consumes its relocation boolean; js/hack.js:pooleffects() awaits js/trap.js:drown().

Other existing direct JavaScript callers are already wired: trap.c:float_down() consumes drown() and js/trap.js:float_down() awaits it; do_wear.c:Amulet_off(), dothrow.c:hurtle_step(), and dbridge.c:e_died() discard the return. Their existing JS paths include do_wear.js and dothrow.js; dbridge.c:e_died() has no equivalent callsite in js/dbridge.js and is unrelated to the selected route.
dependencies: The canonical potion.c:split_mon() is already implemented as js/potion.js:split_mon(); its discarded clone return does not need to be read by trap.c:drown().

The hero clone path is already implemented by mhitu.c:cloneu() in js/mhitu.js, then makemon.c:makemon() and teleport.c:enexto_core()/collect_coords() in existing owners. The queue teleport.c:collect_coords annotation is the first downstream RNG call after the missing split, not the root cause.
The selected entry reaches trap.c:drown() through hack.c:pooleffects(); existing water_damage_chain() and terrain-entry wiring precede the gremlin branch.
